  "workings": "To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd), where E is the market value of equity, D is the market value of debt, V is the total market value of the firm (E + D), Re is the cost of equity, and Rd is the cost of debt. When the company becomes a taxpayer, the formula adjusts to WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd * (1 - T)), where T is the marginal tax rate. Total market value of the firm (V) when tax exempt: (25 + 20) = 45. Weight of equity in capital structure (E/V): (20 / (25 + 20)) = 0.444444. Weight of debt in capital structure (D/V): (25 / (25 + 20)) = 0.555556. WACC when tax exempt: ((20 / (25 + 20)) * 0.2) + ((25 / (25 + 20)) * 0.1) = 0.144444. Weight of equity in capital structure when taxpayer (E/V): (20 / (25 + 20)) = 0.444444. Weight of debt in capital structure when taxpayer (D/V): (25 / (25 + 20)) = 0.555556. Cost of debt after tax: (0.1 * (1 - 0.3)) = 0.07. WACC when taxpayer: ((20 / (25 + 20)) * 0.2) + ((25 / (25 + 20)) * (0.1 * (1 - 0.3))) = 0.127778.",

parsedContent.workings: To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd), where E is the market value of equity, D is the market value of debt, V is the total market value of the firm (E + D), Re is the cost of equity, and Rd is the cost of debt. When the company becomes a taxpayer, the formula adjusts to WACC = (E/V * Re) + (D/V * Rd * (1 - T)), where T is the marginal tax rate. Total market value of the firm (V) when tax exempt: (25 + 20) = 45. Weight of equity in capital structure (E/V): (20 / (25 + 20)) = 0.444444. Weight of debt in capital structure (D/V): (25 / (25 + 20)) = 0.555556. WACC when tax exempt: ((20 / (25 + 20)) * 0.2) + ((25 / (25 + 20)) * 0.1) = 0.144444. Weight of equity in capital structure when taxpayer (E/V): (20 / (25 + 20)) = 0.444444. Weight of debt in capital structure when taxpayer (D/V): (25 / (25 + 20)) = 0.555556. Cost of debt after tax: (0.1 * (1 - 0.3)) = 0.07. WACC when taxpayer: ((20 / (25 + 20)) * 0.2) + ((25 / (25 + 20)) * (0.1 * (1 - 0.3))) = 0.127778.
